The '''''Eta''-class supply barge''' was a type of supply barge<ref name="UVG" /> used by the [[Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Rogue One" /> Larger than the [[Zeta-class Heavy Cargo Shuttle|''Zeta''-class Heavy Cargo Shuttle]], the ''Eta''-class could hold multiple pods aloft on a dorsal cargo bed.<ref name="UVG" />

==Description==
The [[Telgorn Corporation]] presented both the ''Eta''-class supply barge and the [[Zeta-class Heavy Cargo Shuttle|''Zeta''-class Heavy Cargo Shuttle]] as a complete system of logistics vessels. As a result of this, the [[Galactic Empire]] rewarded the corporation with a major [[Imperial Navy]] contract for logistics modernization, and was introduced during the final months of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star's]] construction. The ''Eta''-class was primarily used for strategic spacelift between logistics bases unlike the ''Zeta''-class, which was utilized as tactical delivery to the front line. During the Death Star's construction, it was also used to transport secret cargo along [[Project Stardust]]'s covert supply lines.<ref name="Starships and Speeders" />

One of the key features of both the ''Eta''-class and ''Zeta''-class vessels was the commonality of containers between both ships, which allowed cargo to be sealed and certified at its point of origin and only opened at its destination, despite the possibility of the cargo being transferred between multiple vessels en route to its receiver. Befitting its role in the Imperial logistics chain, the supply barge boasted highly reliable systems, good [[Deflector shield|shields]], and significant cargo capacity at the expense of its speed and offensive capabilities.<ref name="Starships and Speeders" />

The ''Eta''-class mounted racks on both its dorsal and ventral sides, which held twenty and forty-five containers at maximum, respectively. Though Telgorn included mountings for turrets to the fore and aft of the container racks, the Imperial Navy chose not to mount weapons onboard the supply barge, instead relying on dedicated escorts to protect the shipment. This was due largely to research originating from the [[Imperial Naval Academy|Prefsbelt Academy]], though hotly debated among naval theorists, that states that crews of armed transports, such as the [[Gozanti-class cruiser|''Gozanti''-class cruiser]], needlessly endanger their cargo in an attempt to up their kill counts.<ref name="Starships and Speeders" />

==History==
''Eta''-class supply barges were utilized by the Galactic Empire during the early [[Galactic Civil War]]. They were used during the Imperial occupation of [[Jedha]] to transport [[kyber crystal]]s that powered the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star's]] [[Mk I Superlaser]].<ref name="Rogue One" /> In [[5 BBY]],<ref name="Rix Road Date">{{AndorDate|112}}</ref> at least two ''Eta''-class supply barges were present above Scarif as [[Imperial construction droid]]s applied<ref name="Rix Road">{{Andor|Rix Road (episode)}}</ref> [[EP-N5 fastener|EP-N5 fasteners]],<ref name="Dawn of Rebellion">''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]''</ref> which had been constructed by [[prisoners]] from the [[Narkina 5 Imperial Prison Complex]],<ref name="Narkina 5">{{Andor|Narkina 5 (episode)}}</ref> into the [[superlaser]].<ref name="Rix Road" /> Some were present during the [[Battle of Scarif]]<ref name="Rogue One" /> in [[1 BBY]].<ref>''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the [[Battle of Scarif]] to [[1 BBY]].</ref>

Between [[3 ABY]] and [[4 ABY]], the ''Eta''-class supply barge [[SW-0222]], commanded by [[Captain]] [[Corleque]], was taken to the edge of the [[Red Honeycomb Zone]] to perform a cargo trade with the [[Sith Eternal]].<ref name="Vader 46" /> The ship was supposedly carrying a shipment of [[kyberite]], but the vessel actually contained several [[Unidentified monster droid model|monster droids]] and the [[Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]], who were part of an Imperial breakaway faction named the [[Schism Imperial]]. The Sith Eternal were none the wiser and brought Vader and his droids to [[Exegol]].<ref name="Vader 46">[[Darth Vader (2020) 46|''Darth Vader'' (2020) 46]]</ref>
